##### Project general facts

Six Senses Residences is the brand’s first-ever standalone branded residential development, soaring as a world-record tower and redefining sky-high living. Developed by Select Group, this iconic landmark comprises a collection of two to four-bedroom residences, half-floor penthouses, and ultra-luxurious duplex and triplex Sky Mansions. Engineered to promote sustainability and well-being, the tower integrates biophilic principles and classical feng shui throughout its design, creating a home that nurtures both body and soul.

Revolutionizing everyday living, residents are gifted with an extensive array of amenities across four immersive levels. The ‘Connectivity’ level serves as a dynamic hub for work and play, while the ‘Balance’ level offers a state-of-the-art gym, spa with hydrotherapy amenities, and an infinity pool. The ‘Longevity’ level takes wellness further with a dedicated clinic, cryotherapy and hyperbaric chambers, and a crystal sound healing room. Perched on the 109th floor, the ‘Horizon’ level provides a lap pool and breathtaking panoramic views, creating the ultimate retreat above the city.

Every residence is meticulously designed to promote well-being, integrating bespoke timber joinery and delicate bronze accents to cast a warm, golden glow throughout the interiors. Full-height double-glazed windows open onto expansive balconies, commanding sweeping panoramas of Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, and the Arabian Gulf. Select Sky Mansions feature lavish living and dining areas, private gyms, and cinema rooms. Each home is crafted to elevate daily living, offering a sanctuary of understated luxury and holistic harmony.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of the highly sought-after Dubai Marina district, this exceptional address places residents at the core of a cosmopolitan lifestyle with spectacular waterfront views and world-class amenities at their doorstep. Iconic destinations like Palm Jumeirah, JBR The Beach, Bluewaters Island, and the Emirates Golf Club are all within easy reach.

The location is distinguished by its strategic connectivity and vibrant energy. Dubai International Airport is just a short drive away, while key business and leisure hubs are easily accessible, allowing residents to enjoy a dynamic urban rhythm while returning to a serene sanctuary. This unique blend of vibrancy and tranquility makes it the ultimate destination for those seeking a balanced and connected lifestyle.

For those seeking a residence that epitomizes the pinnacle of wellness-focused luxury and a prime address, Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its combination of a prestigious location, a record-breaking tower, and the legendary service of the Six Senses brand makes it one of the world's most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can live in harmony with themselves and the world around them — serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected to the heart of Dubai.
